mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS device_message ( ts TIMESTAMP, device_id LONG, id VARCHAR, report_time LONG, tenant_id LONG, server_id VARCHAR, upstream BOOLEAN, reply BOOLEAN, identifier VARCHAR, request_id VARCHAR, method VARCHAR, params VARCHAR, data VARCHAR, code LONG, msg VARCHAR, raw VARCHAR ) TIMESTAMP(ts) PARTITION BY MONTH WAL DEDUP UPSERT KEYS(ts, device_id, id)
mapper.select: SELECT "column", type, designated, upsertKey FROM table_columns('device_message')
SELECT designatedTimestamp, walEnabled, dedup FROM tables() WHERE table_name = 'device_message'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_message ( ts, device_id, id, report_time, tenant_id, server_id, upstream, reply, identifier, request_id, method, params, data, code, msg, raw ) VALUES ( CAST(#{ts,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP), #{message.deviceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{message.id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message.reportTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{message.tenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{message.serverId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message.upstream,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{message.reply,jdbcType=BOOLEAN}, #{message.identifier,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message.requestId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message.method,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{params,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{data,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{code,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{message.msg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{message.raw,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(ts AS LONG) / 1000 AS ts_ms, device_id, id, report_time, tenant_id, server_id, upstream, reply, identifier, request_id, method, params, data, code, msg, raw FROM device_message
mapper.select:
ORDER BY ts DESC, id DESC
LIMIT #{lo,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{hi,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT count() FROM device_message
AND ts >= CAST(#{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP)

SELECT CAST(timestamp_floor('h', ts) AS LONG) / 1000 AS "time", SUM(CASE WHEN upstream THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upstream_count, SUM(CASE WHEN upstream THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS downstream_count FROM device_message
AND ts >= CAST(#{startTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP)
AND ts <= CAST(#{endTime,jdbcType=BIGINT} AS TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
